    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

['Test input']
def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rb = [i for i in range(H) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1]
    cb = [j for j in range(W) if len(set(grid[i][j] for i in range(H))) == 1]
    sep = grid[rb[0]][0]
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep)
    bg = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def segs(sz, seps):
        out = []; s = 0
        for e in seps + [sz]:
            if e > s: out.append((s, e))
            s = e + 1
        return out
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in segs(H, rb):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in segs(W, cb):
            n = sum(1 for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1) if grid[i][j] != sep and grid[i][j] != bg)
            row.append(1 if n >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
